limitations: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE / NOT MARKET RESULTS - Fabricated v3 contract test fixture.

Hand-authored schematic aggregates: metric values, confusion counts and reliability bins are illustrative placeholders, are not mutually derivable from per-session predictions, and were not produced by the study pipeline or from market data; the historical-looking schema tags and dates are fabricated.
Frozen historical heuristic replay with event inputs zeroed for offline comparison.
Offline baselines (Laplace frequency and multinomial logistic regression) are uncalibrated comparator references.
Historical performance does not guarantee future forecasting efficacy or trading returns.
Test window is not an untouched holdout because the frozen heuristic and protocol were developed with prior knowledge of historical market series.
This study does not evaluate trading performance, slippage, execution cost, or investor financial suitability.
